text:
The Gate 1 revision has been applied to `.sdlc/runs/20261105-105313-feature-new-text-range-styles/requirements.md`:

- **In scope (`IS-1`, `IS-3`, `IS-7`)**: Updated to explicitly cover RTL and mixed-direction text (`isRTL(element.text)` is true) for run splitting, canvas rendering (`dir="rtl"` in `packages/element/src/renderElement.ts` lines 661–676), and SVG export (`direction="rtl"` and `text-anchor="end"` / `"middle"` in `packages/excalidraw/renderer/staticSvgScene.ts` lines 808–814).
- **Functional requirements (`FR-5`, `FR-8`, `FR-15`, and appended `FR-17`)**: Added explicit RTL/mixed-direction requirements stating that LTR left-prefix measurement does not apply when `isRTL(element.text)` is true and that the architect must state how runs and highlight rectangles are positioned for RTL text across `left`, `center`, and `right` alignments on canvas and in SVG export.
- **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1`, `AC-4`)**: Added RTL and mixed-direction run-positioning test cases to `AC-1` and RTL SVG `<tspan>` fill and highlight `<rect>` positioning test cases to `AC-4`. All existing IDs, sections, Gate 0 decisions, and `Open questions for HITL` (`None`) remain unchanged.
